principal_activity: The Company's principal activity during the year continued to be the provision of a premium health club with first class facilities situated in West London. Facilities include a premium gym, indoor and outdoor racket facilities, indoor pool, exercise studios and a member’s area to work, relax and to socialise with other members which is a key feature of the club.

The best-in-class equipment and cherry picked instructors. unlimited classes Hogarth members have unlimited access to a range of holistic, aerobic and HIIT classes across our 3 spacious, air conditioned studios. The results you want. The Hogarth is a leafy jewel set in two acres of beautifully maintained grounds with tennis courts, a pool, the gym, dance studios, a beauty clinic and bar too!
